retrievalProfile.description: A stark, minimalist composition featuring a central red bird silhouette composed of chaotic scribbles against a vast white field with asymmetric typography.
triggerTerms: minimalist red and white album art
asymmetric text layout with central icon

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic design dominated by negative space. The focal point is a red hummingbird silhouette rendered as a dense, chaotic web of overlapping lines and scribbles. The composition is vertically stacked on the right third of the canvas, leaving the left side entirely blank.
coreVisualRelationships: The red scribble bird acts as the central visual anchor.
The script typography at the top balances the heavy sans-serif block at the bottom.
The vast white negative space emphasizes the isolation of the right-aligned elements.
The chaotic texture of the bird contrasts with the clean, geometric lines of the bottom text.
coreInvariants: Contrast between script and sans-serif fonts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-sized bird silhouette positioned in the center-right of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-right script text down to the central red bird, ending at the bottom-right block text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; approximately 70% of the canvas is empty white space on the left.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation red against high-value white and low-value black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of expressive script and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a slanted, high-contrast calligraphic script.
Bottom text uses a wide-tracked, bold, geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus is on tracking and alignment.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of organic script with rigid, wide-spaced sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking in the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the slanted, expressive calligraphic feel of the top text.
Provides the clean, geometric, uppercase foundation for the bottom block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a pure white square canvas. In the center-right, place a red silhouette of a hummingbird. The silhouette should not be solid; it must be filled with a dense, messy web of overlapping red pen-like scribbles and chaotic lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add black text on the right side. At the top right, add a slanted script phrase. At the bottom right, add a three-line block of uppercase sans-serif text with very wide letter spacing, aligned to form a square block.

verificationChecks: Is the left side of the image completely empty?
Is the bird silhouette made of scribbles rather than a solid fill?
Is the bottom text uppercase with wide tracking?
Is the color palette strictly red, black, and white?

adjustableVariables: Exact angle of the top script text
Tracking width of the bottom text
Vertical spacing between the three elements
mustRedesign: Do not use solid fills for the bird; it must be scribbled.
Do not center the composition; it must be right-weighted.

mustAchieve: Clean execution of the scribble texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background with no artifacts.
Ensure the red scribble bird is the only non-text graphic.
Verify the script and sans-serif font contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Right-Aligned Stack + Scribble Silhouette + High-Contrast Typography Pairing
